# SCHEDULE A

September 1, 1978 to January 31, 1979

| Step | Bachelor | Master or * Bachelor $\dagger$ 32 | Master $\dagger$ 32 or *Bachelor $\dagger$ 64 | Earned Doctorate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 11,400 | 12,100 | 12,800 | 13,500 |
| 2 | 11,850 | 12,550 | 13,250 | 13,950 |
| 3 | 12,300 | 13,000 | 13,700 | 14,400 |
| 4 | 13,650 | 14,350 | 15,050 | 15,750 |
| 5 | 14,100 | 14,800 | 15,500 | 16,200 |
| 6 | 14,550 | 15,250 | 15,950 | 16,650 |
| 7 | 15,000 | 15,700 | 16,400 | 17,100 |
| 8 | 15,450 | 16,150 | 16,850 | 17,550 |
| 9 | 15,900 | 16,600 | 17,300 | 18,000 |
| 10 | 16,350 | 17,050 | 17,750 | 18,450 |
| 11 | 16,800 | 17,500 | 18,200 | 18,900 |
| 12 | 17,750 | 18,450 | 19,150 | 19,850 |
| 13 | 19,100 | 19,800 | 20,500 | 21,200 |

\* This phase of the equivalency program is restricted to teachers appointed prior to September 1, 1963. Teachers appointed on or after September 1, 1963 must possess a Master's Degree to be eligible for advanced salary standing.
